notes:
Introducing Fonttrio - the new shadcn/google-fonts :DDD Stop spending time picking fonts, adding them to layout.tsx, and configuring them in globals.css for every typography element. Fonttrio does all of that for you using @shadcn registry:font. I’ve put together a collection

Designer: @kapish_dima. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
